Sebastian Vettel won the most races at the Valencia Street Circuit between 2000 and 2025, with two wins (the European Grand Prix in 2010 and 2011).

The circuit hosted five races in that period, and the other winners were Felipe Massa (2008), Rubens Barrichello (2009) and Fernando Alonso (2012), one win each.

ANSWER: Sebastian Vettel
